free_design.Place: A quiet outdoor mineral pool enclosed by pale limestone columns and flat stone steps on an overcast day.
free_design.Activity: She sits on a dry step above the water, pausing halfway through taking off one neoprene oversleeve before her swim.
free_design.Pose: Seated upright three-quarter toward the viewer, both feet on the dry step. Her left forearm reaches forward with fingers relaxed; her right hand holds the soft oversleeve cuff at the left elbow. Both arms follow plainly from their own shoulders.
free_design.Framing: Portrait 2:3, medium-full three-quarter crop at seated eye height, centering her face, both hands and the edge of the pool.
free_design.Outfit: An opaque juniper-green one-piece swimsuit with scalloped matte binding and a straight square neckline. One detachable neoprene oversleeve is bunched at the elbow as she removes it, revealing the shoulder and upper arm; the swimsuit stays securely in place.
